style: Isometric game sprite for a cosy, painterly small-town builder game, in exactly the drawing style, camera angle, scale of detail and warm lighting of the reference images: a 2:1 isometric view from above, the object's lower-left and lower-right sides visible, as on the references. Detailed painterly rendering like the references: soft shading, textured materials (wood grain, fabric folds, metal sheen), warm late-afternoon autumn light from the upper right and glowing warm lamps; not a flat cartoon, no thick outlines. The whole object fits in the frame with a small margin. Only the object itself: no ground, no grass, no terrain, no people, no scenery. Plain white background.
negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, signature, grass, lawn, ground plane, terrain, scenery, people, crowd, cast shadow on the background, photo, 3d render, front view, side view, flat cartoon, thick outlines, cel shading

items.name: Grandstand S (about 200 seats)
items.prompt: A small temporary golf tournament grandstand for about 200 spectators: a bleacher of eight tiered rows of empty dark green plastic seats on a galvanised aluminium scaffold frame, about 16 m long, 8 m deep and 5 m high at the back. Steel stairs with handrails at both ends, a railing along the top row and the sides, a dark green fabric skirt along the front base with no lettering. The seats face the lower-left of the image.

items.name: Main leaderboard (blank)
items.prompt: The main leaderboard of a golf tournament: a tall freestanding manual scoreboard about 8 m wide and 7 m high, a dark green board in a white frame with a grid of blank white name strips and empty score boxes (completely blank: no letters, no numbers), a small slate-coloured canopy roof on top with a flagpole at each end flying a plain green flag, standing on a scaffold base with a narrow operator walkway and a ladder at the back. The board faces the lower-left of the image.

items.name: Food tent (burger)
items.prompt: A food tent at a golf tournament: a white pagoda marquee tent about 8 m square with a high peaked roof and a scalloped valance, open at the front with a wooden service counter, warm lights inside, a grill and glowing drinks fridges behind the counter, a hanging sign with a picture of a burger (a picture only, no lettering), a few bar stools and potted autumn flowers at the counter. The open front faces the lower-left of the image.

items.name: Toilet block (portable toilets)
items.prompt: A row of six portable toilet cabins for a golf tournament crowd: dark green moulded plastic cabins with white roofs and small vent pipes, standing side by side on a low wooden deck with a ramp at one end and a hand-wash station at the other, about 8 m long, 2 m deep and 2.4 m tall. The cabin doors face the lower-left of the image.

note: hx / hy: half extents of the footprint in metres (X runs down-right on screen, Y down-left); the front faces +Y (lower-left), so flipped it faces +X. prep-golf.mjs sizes each sprite from its footprint: native width 64 * (hx + hy) px.
